autofilltip:
Click: fill one craft
Shift-click: fill the maximum amount
setting-handbook-performance-tooltip: Cached and lazy handbook filtering, faster reopen and close behavior, and related page reuse. Disable this when another mod owns handbook performance patches.
setting-created-by-filter-tooltip: Limit vanilla Created by recipe scans to likely matching grid recipes while handbook pages are composed.
setting-variant-grouping-tooltip: Show one handbook row for duplicate material/geology variants while keeping the original pages searchable and linkable.
setting-mod-category-tab-tooltip: Add the Mods handbook tab and per-mod item/block category list.
setting-bookmarks-tooltip: Add bookmark storage, the Bookmarks handbook tab, and the bookmark detail-page button.
setting-locked-page-tooltip: Add the locked-page detail button and reopen the locked handbook page automatically.
setting-autofill-button-tooltip: Add the handbook Auto-Fill button for craftable items.
setting-uses-button-tooltip: Add the handbook Uses button for opening recipe-use lookup from an item page.
setting-uses-hotkey-tooltip: Register the U hotkey for opening recipe-use lookup from the hovered item.
setting-recipe-overlays-tooltip: Show recipe helper overlays, tool durability markings, max stack size info, and failed Auto-Fill highlights.
setting-slideshow-scroll-tooltip: Allow mouse-wheel control of handbook item and recipe slideshow components.
setting-crafting-output-conflict-scroll-: Allow mouse-wheel selection of alternate crafting-grid outputs when several recipes match the same inputs. Disabled by default because it patches server-side crafting behavior.
setting-generic-container-drop-fix-toolt: Skip unsafe handbook drop previews for generic typed containers that have no stored type.
setting-show-autofill-messages-tooltip: Show chat messages when Auto-Fill succeeds or fails.
setting-info-logging-tooltip: Log one-time BetterHandbook startup and index summary messages.
setting-diagnostic-logging-tooltip: Log detailed recipe, button, and Auto-Fill diagnostics. This is very noisy.
setting-autofill-trace-logging-tooltip: Log every step of shift-left-click Auto-Fill. Only enable while reproducing Auto-Fill bugs.
setting-failure-logging-tooltip: Log recoverable warnings. Errors are always logged.
